verdict.rationale: Fellow’s Developer API and webhook system (fellow-docs-3, fellow-docs-17, fellow-docs-46) could technically be used to push notes into Slack, Notion, or Zapier via custom webhook consumers, but the evidence pack contains no direct mention of a native Zapier app, Slack channel posting, or Notion sync integration. The MCP server (fellow-docs-9, fellow-docs-18) extends AI-tool connectivity but not to these specific destinations. missing for 10: dedicated Zapier app/listing, native Slack channel push, native Notion sync or integration docs.
